  --output_dir output/esj_qwen3_conll_seed123 \
  --batch_size 32 &

  --base_model_path checkpoints/qwen3-8b-fewnerd-5epoch-merged \
  --data_path output/fewnerd_mf4v2_seed42/samples.jsonl \
  --output_dir output/esj_qwen3_fewnerd_seed42 \
  --batch_size 32 &

wait
